roadmap_item.title: Make context retrieval bounded and resumable
roadmap_item.description: Provide small navigation context by default and role-scoped, item-scoped bounded projections for fresh-session resumption.
roadmap_item.rationale: Agents need the active assignment and next action without loading unrelated backlog or full plan history.

goal: A fresh agent can resume an item from a bounded role-scoped context response that contains its active authority, constraints, criteria, next task, blockers, and evidence references.

included: Item and role filters for context
Explicit max-bytes bounds and truncation metadata
Required execution fields and stable detail references
Compact mutation receipts for lifecycle mutations
excluded: Runtime benchmark claims or token telemetry

decisions: Scoped JSON output is measured as encoded UTF-8 bytes and never exceeds max-bytes.
Required fields are retained; optional detail is omitted in deterministic priority order and reported by stable IDs.
Supported roles are implementation, verification, and planning; unknown roles fail explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: Scoped implementation context identifies the active approved assignment, constraints, outstanding criteria, and next action.
Unrelated backlog growth does not increase an item's scoped context output.
Bounded output respects max-bytes and clearly signals truncation with stable references.
Default context is a bounded navigation summary rather than an unbounded artifact dump.
constraints: Do not silently omit required execution constraints.
Keep full artifacts retrievable through existing plan, task, and criterion IDs.
Keep output deterministic for the same database state.

tasks.title: Implement scoped resumable context projections
tasks.description: Add role-aware item context with active plan, criteria, next task, blockers, evidence references, stable detail IDs, and byte-bound truncation.

tasks.title: Reduce default context to navigation data
tasks.description: Replace global backlog and full artifact output with bounded navigation counts and stable item/task/plan references.

tasks.title: Verify fresh-session resumption and output bounds
tasks.description: Exercise small and large fixtures, unrelated backlog growth, truncation, role validation, and CLI receipts.

risks: Very small byte limits may not fit all required fields; the command must reject impossible bounds rather than emit incomplete execution context.
Changing default JSON shape may affect adapters; stable IDs and explicit schema fields will be documented.
